Title: Categorical Foundations of AI Agents
Abstract: arXiv:2611.29998v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We follow the idea of separating intelligence from execution and give the categorical foundations of AI agents: the transformers, the agents, and the orchestrations and choreographies of AI agents are categorized, and which also include their coalgebras and algebras.
translated_abstract: 我们遵循将智能与执行相分离的思想，为AI代理给出范畴论基础：对变换器、AI代理，以及AI代理的编排与协作编排进行了范畴化，其中还包括它们的余代数与代数结构。
tldr: 本文基于智能与执行相分离的思想，为变换器、AI代理及其编排与协作建立了范畴论基础，并涵盖了相应的代数与余代数结构。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes categorical foundations for AI agents by separating intelligence from execution, categorizing transformers, agents, and their orchestrations and choreographies, together with their algebras and coalgebras.
